SB-DEC-015 is CustodyPort abstraction (content-addressed blob storage, integrity verification, residual scanning, backup eligibility). It bears no relationship to recall fusion. Confirms the FO-01 known finding. Correct home is ADR-SB-006.

link_findings.decision_title: V1 exclusions are hard scope controls
link_findings.semantic_relationship: SB-DEC-025 is the v1 exclusion scope-control decision. Two of its many exclusions ('web dashboard', 'productivity scoring') echo ADR consequences, but the decision governs v1 scope (external ingestion, mobile, vector DB, multi-project capture, real Dom data), not the UX contract. Citing it here would make the UX ADR appear to own v1 scope control. Confirms the FO-01 known finding.
SB-DEC-026 is DCP read-first integration and write-authority boundary, not a UX-contract decision. Confirms the FO-01 known finding.

SB-DEC-023.rationale: Deployment-topology constraint (MacBook correctness, Mac mini optional). No ADR candidate covers node topology; R2 governs it in 18_RUNTIME_AND_DEPLOYMENT_TOPOLOGY.md. SB-DEC-002 already carries the deployable-footprint consequence cited by ADR-SB-001. No ADR was broadened to absorb it.

SB-DEC-025.decision_title: V1 exclusions are hard scope controls
SB-DEC-025.rationale: Hard v1 scope control spanning dashboards, visualization, external ingestion, mobile, vector DB, automation, productivity scoring, real Dom data, and multi-project capture. Scope-only decision per the no-one-to-one-coverage rule; attaching it to the UX ADR would misattribute v1 scope authority.

SB-DEC-026.rationale: DCP read-first integration. Partially adjacent to ADR-SB-001 (extension boundary and non-authority), but ADR-SB-001 contains no facade, sanitized-recall, or identity-gate content. Linkage is AMBIGUOUS, so no ADR was broadened; recorded as an observation for the ADR-acceptance gate.

SB-DEC-028.decision_title: Audit receipts are append-only and content-minimized
SB-DEC-028.rationale: Append-only, content-minimized receipts spanning capture, review, promotion, policy, projection, spool, and purge. Cross-cutting across ADR-SB-002/004/005/006/007; attaching it to any single ADR would be arbitrary and attaching it to all five would broaden five ADRs for coverage.

SB-DEC-031.decision_title: Runtime and benchmark claims remain NOT_RUN
SB-DEC-031.rationale: Claims/evidence discipline holding all runtime conformance, latency, retrieval quality, purge completeness, offline sync, and isolation measurements NOT_RUN. Already expressed uniformly in every ADR's acceptance condition 'No runtime, implementation, or production claim is inferred from acceptance', which is the discipline applied across all ten ADRs rather than a standalone architectural choice. Option B under the packet's SB-DEC-031 adjudication. No ADR cites it; none was broadened to.

SB-DEC-032.decision_title: Observed remote drift is non-material to this candidate
SB-DEC-032.rationale: Historical evidence observation recording remote main 17ddf9aa716956af9cd07f738c08b646edfeabee as advanced from the discovery base, with web-observation evidence pointers. Not an architectural choice; no ADR created and none broadened.
